notes:
Test-quality finding for the reviewer: the test 'Enter in the question of an ask holding two lists keeps every word' (packages/dispatch/e2e/ask-concurrent-edit.e2e.ts:149) calls placeCaret(alicePage, 'after', 'Which one?'). placeCaret takes the first occurrence, which is in the malformed banner (contenteditable=false), because the banner quotes the question. Probe T9 ran the test's own steps: the selection anchor was the banner

at offset 34, and the stored result was '- Option B * * MoreOption A' (More went into the second list). Probe T8 put the caret in the editable question: Enter does not split the paragraph (the content match refuses it, as ask-content.ts documents) and More is added to the question ('Which one?More'). Every word stays in both cases. No test exercises Enter in the question of a broken ask. The plan's gap analysis named this e2e step as that check.

Not a defect of this change (the same at b295a3fb and at the head): Enter twice at the end of the last option of a valid decision gives '- Option AOutside\n- ', the empty-option class that the reproduction comment names.
